addons.name: Azeroth FieldKit Reborn
addons.author: Kevin Radlowski / Maidenhead; MASH by Malk
addons.description: Combat HUD, damage/healing meters, campaign bosses, jewelry, world markers and themed/native HUD presets for Reborn.

reborn.notes: Client 0.6.9: distinct hit/crit records for spells sharing icons, stable spell ID lookup, improved meter contrast and readable damage columns. Maintainer passed in-game recipe on 2026-11-20. Automated API, locale, settings and packaging checks pass. Existing profiles preserved. Live co-op/Endless and game-team security certification are not claimed. See stable .38 release and rights notices.

addons.name: Azeroth Stats Reborn
addons.author: Kevin / Maidenquinn
addons.description: Run history, combat analysis, builds, progression, themes and shared local backups for Azeroth Survivors Reborn.

reborn.notes: Single-player recipe passed on 0.6.7: history, themes, icons, shared defaults, in-addon migration, reload persistence, classic rollback and safety recovery. Automated and installed-API checks pass. Requires bundled AzerothSurvivorsAPI. Co-op and all class/resolution combinations are not independently certified. See bundled notices.

addons.name: Reborn Build Planner
addons.author: Maidenquinn / Maidenhead
addons.description: Plan, capture live runs, import and track class builds with a read-only HUD, spell priorities and equipment alternatives.

reborn.notes: Author-tested v0.5.1: capture current run, observed banishments preserved across reloads, improved legendary amulet identification, minimap launcher, import/export and read-only tracker. Author confirms catalogue redistribution permission. Requires bundled AzerothSurvivors and AzerothSurvivorsAPI. Game-client certification pending; no automated gameplay actions.
